title: Spite
description:
Deal 5 damage.
If you lost HP this turn,

upgraded_description:

notes: Deals damage with a conditional multiplier—if you've taken unblocked damage this turn, the attack hits multiple times instead of once. The hit count is determined by the Repeat var (2 base, 3 upgraded).
